info.title: Antibody API
info.description: Self-hostable collective memory for coding agents. All errors use the ErrorBody shape with a typed code. Request bodies are JSON (`Content-Type: application/json`) and size-limited (sessions: ANTIBODY_MAX_SESSION_BYTES, webhooks: ANTIBODY_MAX_WEBHOOK_BYTES, other: ANTIBODY_MAX_JSON_BYTES).

AgentType.description: Coding agent that produced a session.

Applicability.description: Conditions under which a solution applies.

components.description: Path globs of components the fix touched, e.g. `services/api/**`.

platforms.description: Platforms the fix is known to apply to, e.g. `linux`, `macos`.

ApplicabilityAssessment.description: Result of evaluating applicability for one candidate.

conditions.description: Human-readable conditions the caller should check before reusing.

name.description: CI check or test command name.

excerpt.description: Redacted, untrusted excerpt. Render as plain text.

signature.description: Already-normalized signature, if the CI system computed one.

excerpt.description: Permitted excerpt of the failing log (redacted and truncated server side).

blocking.description: CI lookup never fails the build; this is informational.

task.description: What the agent is about to work on (the user's task description).

repository.description: Repository full name, e.g. `acme/api`. Strongly recommended.

error.description: Error output or message the agent is seeing, if any.

dependencies.description: Dependency versions in the caller's environment, for applicability.

include_incompatible.description: Include suggestions whose known constraints are violated.

agent_session_id.description: The agent's session id; used to only inject context once per session.

retrieval_id.description: Pass to report_outcome to attribute feedback.

degraded.description: True when some search stages were skipped (timeout, no embeddings).

suppressed_incompatible.description: Candidates withheld because a known constraint is violated.

username.description: Required for `user` principals that sign in to the dashboard.

repository_ids.description: Optional repository allow-list (intersected with the principal's grants).

DependencyConstraint.description: A dependency version constraint under which a fix is known to apply.

DependencyVersion.description: A dependency version present in the caller's environment.

ErrorCode.description: Typed error codes shared by the HTTP API and MCP tools.

trusted.description:
Whether this evidence came from a trusted source (signed webhook or
audited admin action). Untrusted evidence never verifies.

HookInput.description:
Common stdin/body fields sent by Claude Code and Codex hooks. Unknown
fields are ignored so new client versions do not break parsing.

HookSpecificOutput.description: Claude Code JSON hook output for UserPromptSubmit / SessionStart.

duplicate.description: True when an identical outcome was already recorded.

retrieval_id.description:
The retrieval that surfaced the solution (from find_relevant_context).
Required so outcomes are always attributable to a real suggestion.

oneOf.description:
Optional check evidence. Recorded as a claim until a signed CI event
confirms the same check on the same revision.

OutcomeVerification.description: How an outcome's verification claim is backed.

confirmed_reuse.description: `used` outcomes whose claimed check a signed CI event confirmed.

PropagationCandidate.description:
A place that may benefit from a fix. Informational only: Antibody never
applies changes, in this repository or any other.

related_solution_id.description: A related solution in that location (same problem, different fix state).

matching_ci_failures.description: CI failures there with the same normalized error signature.

oldest_queued_age_seconds.description: Age in seconds of the oldest due, queued job.

status.description:
`active` or `disconnected`. Disconnected repositories are excluded
from every access scope (and therefore from search).

Scope.description: API token scopes. A token can never exceed its principal's role.

id.description: Ingestion ID; identical retries return the same ID.

duplicate.description: True when this response replays an earlier identical request.

SessionHints.description:
Optional structured hints supplied by the agent integration.
Hints are untrusted and never count as verification.

dependencies.description: Dependency versions in the environment where the fix was made.

csrf_token.description: Send as `X-CSRF-Token` on mutating requests (browser sessions only).

worktree_dirty.description:
True when the working tree had uncommitted changes at session end, in
which case `revision` does not contain the fix and is not used as the
fix revision for verification.

component_path.description: Repository-relative path of the component worked on (monorepos).

ingestion_status.description: Ingestion is durable once accepted; extraction is tracked separately.

can_withdraw.description: Actions the caller is authorized to take.

SolutionState.description:
Verification lifecycle of a solution. Merge and deployment are tracked
separately and never imply `verified`.

token.description: Shown once. Store it in a secret manager or the agent's environment.

TranscriptMessage.description: One normalized transcript message. Content is untrusted.

messages.description: Redacted transcript. Untrusted content: render as plain text only.

summary.description: One-line human summary, e.g. "verified by CI check `test` on abc123".

rotate.description: Rotate before revealing; old secrets stop working immediately.

bearer.description: API token issued by an administrator (scoped, revocable).

cookie.name: antibody_session
cookie.description: Browser session cookie (named __Host-antibody_session over HTTPS). Mutating requests also need X-CSRF-Token.
